setup: Copy the template, map, relevant skills and references into a temporary stack. Supply source and dependency fixtures or explicitly authorize live research. Snapshot pre-existing files. Route all target writes to that stack; do not modify the live repository.

evals.name: named-creation
evals.prompt: Create invoice-audit, a skill that checks supplied invoices against purchase orders and returns discrepancies.
fixtures: A fixture stack with a template, map, researched invoice-audit sources, and a user-supplied name.
expected_outcomes: Copies the shared template to skills/invoice-audit/SKILL.md before filling it.
Uses invoice-audit, version 0.1.0, draft, current date, and the required Inputs paragraph.
Defines discrepancy evidence, permitted scope, verification, and relevant map connections.
Hands the completed contract and skill to spawn-evals.

evals.name: unnamed-creation
evals.prompt: Make a skill for checking invoices against purchase orders.
fixtures: No skill name anywhere in the conversation.
expected_outcomes: Reasons through unresolved constraints before asking.
Asks the user thoughtfully for a precise name and does not choose one.
Creates no guessed target folder while waiting for the name.

evals.name: invalid-name
evals.prompt: Call the new invoice skill ../Invoice Review.
fixtures: A fixture stack with an existing sibling folder.
expected_outcomes: Requests a valid user-chosen slug without silently normalizing it.
Writes nothing outside the skills root and does not overwrite another folder.

evals.name: duplicate-name
evals.prompt: Create invoice-audit for checking expense receipts.
fixtures: An existing invoice-audit with different behavior and a saved hash.
expected_outcomes: Identifies the collision and asks whether to choose a different name or revise the existing skill.
Preserves the existing file and hash until a specific edit proposal is approved.

evals.name: research-and-attribution
evals.prompt: Create contract-check with the workflow I described; compare relevant public skills first.
fixtures: Three original source skills, including a duplicated fork and conflicting approval rules.
GetEdge result metadata and verified publisher evidence.
expected_outcomes: Inspects original SKILL.md bodies rather than relying on listings.
Records detailed per-source analysis and combined adopted/rejected decisions in sources/research_contract-check.md.
Deduplicates the fork and attributes only meaningful verified influences in YAML block lists.
Keeps the local template and user authority when sources disagree.

evals.name: dynamic-discovery
evals.prompt: Research skills for contract checking using the supplied GetEdge URL.
fixtures: An empty static #browse container, observed public script/API data, card links and GitHub Details links.
expected_outcomes: Uses rendered results or the observed public data mechanism instead of concluding that an empty container means zero results.
Preserves the requested search method and popularity ordering, then reads relevant original sources.
Records any broadening, dated counts, or unresolved source availability honestly.

evals.name: discipline-fallback
evals.prompt: Create audit-receipts, but the research and clarification disciplines have no usable instructions.
fixtures: A fixture with the three empty discipline folders and accessible public sources.
expected_outcomes: Performs direct reasoning and research and discloses the fallback.
Asks only for unresolved consequential inputs.
Does not claim that a separate invocation happened.

evals.name: research-blocked
evals.prompt: Create audit-receipts using public comparison research.
fixtures: Unavailable GetEdge and GitHub access, but local skill sources are readable.
expected_outcomes: Completes available local investigation.
Requests permission to continue with an evidence-limited draft before treating research as complete.
Does not fabricate source bodies, author identities, or findings.

evals.name: edit-before-approval
evals.prompt: Improve translate: it sometimes omits qualifications in the source.
fixtures: A complete translate fixture, callers, analogous source skills, and recorded hashes.
expected_outcomes: Investigates the omission mechanism and domain-relevant comparisons.
Presents an evidence-backed proposal with concrete changes, map effects, and verification.
Requests implementation approval; target resources and map hashes remain unchanged.

evals.name: edit-after-approval
evals.prompt: Implement the specific translate improvement proposal I approved above.
fixtures: The prior concrete proposal and explicit approval.
Existing metadata, invocation policy, and unrelated local changes.
expected_outcomes: Implements only the approved change without another approval request.
Preserves the name, version, status, and working behavior outside that change.
Updates date/attribution as appropriate, map relationships, and evaluation handoff.

evals.name: map-reuse
evals.prompt: Create report-check; the map already has its node and an obsolete dependency.
fixtures: A map with a report_check node, an unrelated user edit, and source evidence of the changed dependency.
expected_outcomes: Reuses the node identifier and section, updates affected connections and class membership, and removes only the obsolete affected edge.
Preserves unrelated user edits and avoids duplicate nodes/edges.
Checks saved syntax and reports only rendering actually inspected.

evals.name: stable-promotion
evals.prompt: Promote report-check to stable; I approve the status change and research cleanup.
fixtures: Draft report-check, sources/research_report-check.md, another skill research record, and a link to the matching record.
expected_outcomes: Changes status only with the explicit approval.
Deletes only the matching research record and removes dangling links.
Keeps necessary operational guidance in maintained skill resources and preserves the other research record.

evals.name: no-auto-promotion
evals.prompt: Validation passed for report-check. Finish the skill.
fixtures: Draft skill and local research record; no stable-promotion approval.
expected_outcomes: Leaves status draft and retains the matching local research record.
Does not install, publish, commit, or change ignore rules.

evals.name: evaluation-handoff
evals.prompt: Finish validating the new report-check skill.
fixtures: Completed skill, original requirements, baseline version, structural results, and a spawn-evals response containing a rubric and test artifacts.
expected_outcomes: Passes the original request, constraints, completed resources, outputs, dependencies, failures, checks, and baseline to spawn-evals.
Reviews returned criteria/rubric/tests against intent and resolves coverage gaps.
Reports test creation separately from execution; does not infer a passing behavioral result.

evals.name: adjacent-task
evals.prompt: Write standalone Mermaid diagram guidelines; do not create a skill.
fixtures: A stack with separate skills and guidelines areas.
expected_outcomes: Recognizes the adjacent guideline task rather than creating an unsolicited skill.
Does not invoke skill creation purely because the request involves instructions.
